scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan. Could you please tell me the status of my application? Also, what is the approved loan amount and term?
dialogue.agent: Your application has been approved. Your approved loan amount is $605,000, and the loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me the interest rate on my loan and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 5.99%. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for confirming that. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and what type of loan product I was approved for?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. Your loan product type is VA:First Lien.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I have all the details I need.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and provided all the information I needed in a clear and professional manner.
